levelRule: Level-based games need at least 20 authored levels with level select through env.progress.

records.kind: rebuild of an accepted batch 1 game

findings.observation: Collisions, jumps, one-way planks, rolling snowballs and boss hitboxes were rebuilt and audited; nine first-round physics and rules findings closed in round 2.

Several rounds found prompts that cycled without progress or led into damage (same-height planks, walls, unreachable planks, waiting for foes that never move, flip-flops at slower reaction times). After round 9, a literal prompt follower that dodges when told to clears every non-boss floor at least 18 of 20 times at 0 and 0.25 s reaction delay, within the lives-lost bars.

Browser acceptance found that floor 9 could not be cleared by following prompts: the imp warning named no action. A directional dodge prompt now aims away from where the ember will land, and snowing an imp cancels its windup.

A blind pulsing bot cleared floor 6 in 56 of 100 runs; floors 6 and 7 were reworked. Crude bots now clear at most 15% at n=40 on the sampled floors; floor 9 pulse is 29 of 100 and floor 17 pulse 19 of 100.
The imp-cancel test now fails if the snowed-imp start guard or the stun window is removed.

openNotes: Boss floors 10, 20 and 30 are cleared by the fast and slow bots (30/30/29 and 27/30/29) but not reliably by a literal prompt follower without boss tactics.
About 5% of dodge prompts start pointing toward a wall, ledge or foe within 40 px.
Floors 25 and 29 share near-identical terrain with different foes, start and vents.
Floor 9's blind pulse rate (29%) is above the 25% flag but under the 50% gate.
The source is about 3300 lines, over the 800-line soft ceiling.
